verdict.rationale: Increase provides webhooks and Real-Time Decision objects so external systems can react to events (transaction attempts, card authorizations) and even approve/decline in real time, which enables event-driven automation, but there is no evidence of a built-in declarative rules engine or dashboard for defining conditional rules — the actual rule logic must be implemented in the customer's own server code. Missing for 10: a native rules/automation builder, examples of AI-defined conditional triggers, and any UI for specifying rules without custom code.
